Using the determinant condition for collinearity:

\[
\begin{vmatrix} a-1 & 1 \\ -b-1 & 2 \end{vmatrix}=0
\]

\[
2(a-1)-1(-b-1)=0 \Rightarrow 2a+b=1
\]

Minimize \(\frac1a+\frac2b\) subject to \(2a+b=1\), \(a,b>0\).

By AM-GM,

\[
(2a+b)\left(\frac1a+\frac2b\right)
=4+\frac{4a}{b}+\frac{b}{a}
\ge 4+2\sqrt4=8
\]

Since \(2a+b=1\),

\[
\frac1a+\frac2b \ge 8
\]

Equality when \(\frac{4a}{b}=\frac{b}{a}\), i.e. \(b=2a\), and \(2a+b=1\), giving \(a=\frac14\), \(b=\frac12\).

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
